text: Last week I promised you gold trousers. This is a gold helmet. Close enough. The robot mined the gold, smelted it, made the helmet, and wore it into the Nether. Full health.
Problem one. Night falls, and every place to dig in is under water. The old robot floated in the lake till morning, with dry land in plain view. Now it swims for the shore and digs in.
Problem two. Hoglins. Forty health, and they throw you. We sent the robot in with a stone sword. It left by the ledge.
Now it hunts hoglins only in iron or better, weapon and chestplate. Otherwise it goes back to the Overworld and bothers a sheep.

The numbers. In the lake, none of four runs got out before. After, every valid run made the shore. Hoglins: two deaths in two, down to one, and that one was a piglin. Helmets: two runs, two hats, no deaths.
Version zero point nine five point six two. Out now. Bring a hat.
